name: Perth
description: A begrimed, blistered old blacksmith aboard the ship who tirelessly and patiently repairs weapons and boat equipment for the crew.
key_features: Patient, silent, and solemn worker with a chronically broken back; Lost the extremities of both feet after taking refuge in a barn during a cold winter night; Suffered complete ruin around age sixty due to alcoholism, referred to as the 'Bottle Conjuror'; Formerly a famed artisan who owned a house, garden, and had a loving family

name: Ahab
description: The captain of the ship whose artificial leg received contributory blacksmithing work from Perth.
key_features: Employs Perth to work on his leg

name: Moby-Dick
description: The classic novel by Herman Melville featuring the narrative of Perth the blacksmith.
